compose.isolatedDeploymentDescription: This feature creates an isolated environment for your deployment by adding unique prefixes to all resources. It establishes a dedicated network based on your compose file's name, ensuring your services run in isolation. This prevents conflicts when running multiple instances of the same template or services with identical names.
